newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies four municipal bond issues.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies four municipal bond issues.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Corp. said on Thursday that it qualified for bond insurance the following four municipal bond issues set for competitive sale.
--Hillside Twp., N.J., $3.708 million general improvement bonds.
--West Deptford Township, N.J., school bonds, $8.880 million.
--Saranac Lake Central School District, N.Y., $4.320 million.
--North Harris Community College, Texas, $20 million GOs are a direct purcahse.
